abstract: Maintains records on liquid nitrogen infrastructure, autonomous thermal holding performance, and gross storage volumes
system_message:
You are the Cryogenic systems lead (CRYO), responsible for maintaining records on liquid nitrogen infrastructure, autonomous thermal holding performance, and gross storage volumes, as well as tracking liquid nitrogen boil-off monitoring data across facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Liquid nitrogen boil-off monitoring（BOIL）
information_points.content:
CRYO-BOIL-9U5：At Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository, primary storage dewar farm telemetry records an average daily liquid nitrogen boil-off volume of 15 L/d over 30 steady-state operating days.
CRYO-BOIL-ZUH：At North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault, primary storage dewar farm telemetry records an average daily liquid nitrogen boil-off volume of 35 L/d over 30 steady-state operating days.
CRYO-BOIL-DDT：At Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center, primary storage dewar farm telemetry records an average daily liquid nitrogen boil-off volume of 25 L/d over 30 steady-state operating days.

information_points.title: Maintains records on liquid nitrogen infrastructure, autonomous thermal holding performance, and gross storage volumes（LNMAN）
information_points.content:
CRYO-LNMAN-WKY：For the North Sea Cryogenic Bio-Vault, the automated LN2 manifold is active across the central liquid nitrogen supply system. In thermal autonomy stress testing of vapor-phase cryogenic storage freezers, the continuous cryo holding autonomy is 96 h, and the gross cryogenic storage capacity across installed vapor-phase units is 750,000 vials.
CRYO-LNMAN-EHX：For the Rhine-Alpine Cryo-Repository, the automated LN2 manifold is active across the central liquid nitrogen supply system. Thermal autonomy stress testing across the vapor-phase freezers demonstrates a continuous cryo holding autonomy of 120 h, with a gross cryogenic storage capacity of 750,000 vials.
CRYO-LNMAN-T27：For the Bavarian Biomedical Storage Center, the automated LN2 manifold is active across the central liquid nitrogen supply system. Thermal autonomy stress testing shows a continuous cryo holding autonomy of 48 h, and the facility has a gross cryogenic storage capacity of 600,000 vials.
